item.title: Principal Consultant - Generalist
item.description:
The opportunity
As a Principal Consultant at Proxima, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, leading complex, high‑value engagements and shaping transformational outcomes. You will combine deep subject matter expertise with strong leadership, influencing both client strategy and delivery while developing Proxima’s people and capabilities.

This is a senior, hands‑on role for consultants who thrive in ambiguity, enjoy leading teams, and want to have a lasting impact on clients and the firm.

item.title: Senior Consultant - Directs Procurement
item.description:
The opportunity
As a Senior Consultant at Proxima in our Directs practice, you will lead complex workstreams and manage senior stakeholders while delivering innovative solutions and mentoring junior consultants. You will be part of client-facing teams delivering high-impact commercial, sourcing, and supplier initiatives, supporting the development of insights, contributing to solution design, and playing an active role in delivering outcomes, not just recommendations.

item.title: Consultant - Generalist
item.description:
The opportunity
As a Consultant at Proxima, you will be part of client-facing teams delivering high-impact commercial, sourcing, and supplier initiatives. You will support the development of insights, contribute to solution design, and play an active role in delivering outcomes, not just recommendations.

This is not a passive learning role. At Proxima, we are practitioner-consultants. You will build experience quickly, take responsibility early, and work alongside clients to deliver real, measurable change.

item.title: Vice President - Technology Procurement
item.description:
The opportunity
As a Vice President at Proxima in our IT and Technology practice, you will provide executive leadership across clients, teams, and the firm. This role blends deep domain expertise, client delivery, business development, and thought leadership.

You will lead high‑risk, high‑growth client programs, shape long‑term client strategy, and play a key role in Proxima’s continued growth and market positioning.

item.title: Senior Vice President- Consulting
item.description:
The opportunity 

As a Senior Vice President at Proxima, you will shape the direction of our client relationships, our people and our business. You will hold executive accountability for a portfolio of clients, combining commercial ownership with delivery leadership to create measurable, lasting value.

item.title: Principal Consultant- Procurement IT Services
item.description:
What you’ll do

Support delivery across client engagements

  • Lead and manage global teams across complex client engagements.

  • Develop and execute category strategies across IT Services, including professional services, managed services, outsourcing, systems integration, and application development and support.
